nodes.label: Meeting Room — La Nube Polo Tecnológico
nodes.description: Interior photograph of the La Nube Polo Tecnológico meeting room. Features a rectangular light-wood conference table with 6 mesh-back chairs (white frames). A large wall-mounted display shows the La Nube Polo Tecnológico branded logo screen. A webcam/video-conferencing camera is mounted above the display. On the table: a tablet control panel, a wireless keyboard, and a conference speakerphone/microphone; an in-table cable management tray is visible. Natural light enters from a window on the left. Tile floor. A door is visible on the right. The setup is clean, modern, and technology-equipped for video conferencing and in-person meetings.
